'''Companion Cresh''' was a distant satellite dwarf [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The dwarf galaxy lay well beyond the 150,000 [[Light-year/Legends|light year]] distance of the satellite galaxy [[Firefist|Companion Besh]].<ref name="TEA" /> Companion Cresh was, according to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], officially classified as part of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The dwarf galaxy partially shared its name with the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] [[Writing/Legends|letter]] [[Cresh/Legends|Cresh]].<ref name="Aurebesh">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref> On the twelfth [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of the [[Baobab Merchant Marine Academy, Manda: Officer Candidate School Orientation|Officer Candidate School Orientation]] class at the [[Baobab Merchant Marine Academy]], the [[Teacher/Legends|instructor]] [[Crix Q5 Baobab]] educated [[Gender/Legends|his]] students on dwarf satellite galaxies, including Companion Cresh.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Companion Cresh was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TEA" />
